title: Enhancing Foundation VLM Robustness to Missing Modality: Scalable Diffusion for Bi-directional Feature Restoration
reasoning: The paper is a technical research contribution focused on improving the robustness of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) through a diffusion-based feature restoration method. While it utilizes a hate speech detection dataset (MMHS11K) for benchmarking its model's performance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study.
